Pure PRODUCT_IMPLEMENTATION or DEPLOYMENT_EVIDENCE P0 rows with independently established no preactivation control-authority impact are excluded from CURRENT_CONTROL_P0 without changing their source finding status.
UNKNOWN/conflicting applicability, domain, or control impact remains blocking pending classification.
Only RESOLVED, CLOSED, SUPERSEDED are terminal nonblocking unless a canonical schema explicitly adds another terminal nonblocking state.
Explicit active-law supersession may project an old-law finding to effective SUPERSEDED while preserving original historical evidence.
OPEN_CONTROL_P0_COUNT must derive only after projection of every finding row.
REQUIRED_REFINEMENTS: Pin every projection generation to an exact CONTROL_COMMIT and CONTROL_TREE; a projection over a moving FINDINGS directory is not a complete manifest proof.

Persist a COMPLETE_FINDING_MANIFEST_ROOT_HASH over every projection source row, in addition to CONTROL_P0_SET_ROOT_HASH over eligible control-P0 rows, so denominator completeness and selected control-P0 set are independently bound.

Normalize P0 class only from explicit canonical severity/priority fields or an authoritative schema mapping. Mere textual 'P0' mentions are not severity evidence; conflicting/missing severity remains UNKNOWN.
Define CONTROL_P0_ELIGIBILITY values explicitly, e.g. ELIGIBLE_CONTROL_P0, NOT_CONTROL_P0, BLOCKING_PENDING_CLASSIFICATION, and count the pending state as blocking for zero proof.
For domain=MIXED, require explicit evidence of whether the control component is a PREACTIVATION_AUTHORITY_BLOCKER. Unknown control impact remains blocking.
Supersession evidence must be applicable to the active law and temporally valid at the pinned projection snapshot; a historical or candidate supersession record is insufficient.

Immediately before any Phase-1 zero proof, rescan the current control tree. If FINDINGS path/blob membership differs from the pinned projection denominator, invalidate the zero proof and rebuild/rebase.
